component.name: Atlas
component.summary: A workspace over plain files: notes, papers, mail, code and terminals

description.p: Atlas is a fast desktop workspace over a folder of plain files. Notes render like Obsidian, with wikilinks, embeds, callouts, LaTeX and Bases tables; papers come with their PDFs and annotations; code gets language servers; terminals run beside your notes. Plugins in plain JavaScript add the rest.
